stem: You have just installed Terraform on a new laptop. What is the quickest way to confirm the binary is on your PATH and the correct version is active?
options: Open the HashiCorp website and compare the download checksum
Run `terraform -help` and read the list of subcommands
Run `which terraform` and inspect the file path
Run `terraform -version` and read the version number it prints
objective: Explain what terraform -version reports and why it is useful after installation

stem: A colleague asks how to find out which subcommands Terraform supports without leaving the terminal. What should they run?
objective: Explain what terraform -help reports and why it is useful after installation

stem: After running `terraform -help` you see a subcommand called `workspace` but you are unsure what it does. What is the most direct next step?
options: Run `terraform -version` to check if the subcommand is available in your version
Run `terraform -help workspace` to see workspace-specific options
Run `terraform workspace` without arguments and read the error
objective: Explain what terraform -help reports and why it is useful after installation
